scope: Read-only audit of five existing Singapore public-access candidate outlets whose Directory Menu / Price and Menu URL fields are blank. Public Foodpanda outlet-specific pages were used only where branch names and precise street/unit/postal details match the SFA record. Extracted factual item names/prices only; no images or platform descriptions reused; no paid services or account access.

reviewed_but_not_proposed.result: Following current linked outlet entry redirected to generic Singapore city page on 2026-10-19; not considered a valid publicly accessible branch menu for this audit.

limitations: Foodpanda pages provide outlet-specific delivery menus; listed prices may differ from in-store prices.
A displayed page menu does not independently certify dine-in availability or permanent operating status.
The delivery page image assets and descriptive copy were not reused; no image rights were assessed.
This is a limited cross-section and not a nationwide completeness claim.
